articles.title_en: The Power of Certainty: Experimental Evidence on the Effective Design of Free Tuition Programs
articles.title_cn: 确定性的力量：免费学费项目有效设计的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Proposed “free college” policies vary widely in design. The simplest set tuition to zero for everyone. More targeted approaches limit free tuition to those who demonstrate need through an application process. We experimentally test the effects of these two models on the schooling decisions of low-income students. An unconditional free tuition offer from a large public university substantially increases application and enrollment rates. A free tuition offer contingent on proof of need has a much smaller effect on application and none on enrollment. These results are consistent with students placing a high value on financial certainty when making schooling decisions. (JEL H52, H75, I22, I23, I28, I32)
articles.abstract_cn: 拟议中的“免费大学”政策在设计上差异很大。最简单的做法是将所有人的学费设为零。更有针对性的方法是通过申请程序，将免费学费限制在那些证明有需要的学生。我们通过实验检验了这两种模式对低收入学生求学决策的影响。一所大型公立大学提供的无条件免费学费大幅提高了申请率和入学率。而附带经济需求证明条件的免费学费对申请的影响要小得多，对入学则没有影响。这些结果与学生在做出求学决策时高度重视财务确定性是一致的。（JEL H52, H75, I22, I23, I28, I32）

articles.title_en: A Characterization for Optimal Bundling of Products with Nonadditive Values
articles.title_cn: 非加性价值产品最优捆绑销售的特征化描述
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the optimal bundling of products with nonadditive values. Under monotonic preferences and single-peaked profits, I show that a monopolist finds pure bundling optimal if and only if the optimal sales volume for the grand bundle is larger than the optimal sales volume for any smaller bundle. I then detail how my analysis relates to ratio monotonicity results on bundling and describe the implications for nonlinear pricing. (JEL D21, D42, L12, L25)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了具有非加性价值的产品的最优捆绑销售问题。在单调偏好和单峰利润条件下，我证明了垄断者认为纯捆绑销售是最优的，当且仅当大捆绑的最优销售量大于任何较小捆绑的最优销售量。随后，我详细阐述了我的分析与捆绑销售中的比率单调性结果之间的关系，并描述了其对非线性定价的启示。（JEL D21, D42, L12, L25）

articles.title_en: Reducing Frictions in Health Care Access: The ActionHealthNYC Experiment for Undocumented Immigrants
articles.title_cn: 减少医疗保健获取中的摩擦：针对无证移民的ActionHealthNYC实验
articles.abstract_en: In 2016, New York City designed and implemented an intervention to reduce frictions in accessing safety net care: randomly making initial primary care appointments for 2,428 undocumented immigrants. We leverage a novel survey-administrative data linkage to show that the program increased self-reported access to primary care, leading to 23 percent fewer emergency department (ED) visits. High-risk individuals’ ED visits fell by 32 percent on average, driving the aggregate effect. Preventive care also increased among individuals visiting sponsored clinics. (JEL H75, I11, I12, I13, I14, I18, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 在2016年，纽约市设计并实施了一项干预措施，以减少获取安全网护理的摩擦：随机为2,428名无证移民安排初次初级保健预约。我们利用一项新颖的调查-行政数据关联表明，该计划增加了自我报告的初级保健获取，导致急诊科就诊次数减少了23%。高风险个体的急诊就诊平均减少了32%，推动了总体效应。在赞助诊所就诊的个体中，预防性护理也有所增加。（JEL H75, I11, I12, I13, I14, I18, J15）

articles.title_en: A Minimalist Model for the Ruble during the Russian Invasion of Ukraine
articles.title_cn: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间卢布的极简模型
articles.abstract_en: This note isolates an overlooked economic force for the ruble to appreciate in response to international sanctions limiting exports to Russia. The intuition is that when Russians are unable to buy the mix of foreign goods they wish, foreign goods become less attractive, increasing demand for domestic goods. To reestablish an equilibrium, a real appreciation is needed to raise the relative price of domestic goods and incentivize imports from nonsanctioning countries. We also review well-known forces for depreciation. Our analysis emphasizes that the exchange rate is an inadequate signal of the welfare impact and of the effectiveness of sanctions. (JEL D74, E31, F14, F31, F51, P24, P33)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文揭示了一个被忽视的经济力量，即国际制裁限制对俄出口时，卢布会升值。其直觉是，当俄罗斯人无法购买他们想要的外国商品组合时，外国商品的吸引力下降，从而增加了对国内商品的需求。为了重新建立均衡，需要实际升值以提高国内商品的相对价格，并激励从非制裁国家的进口。我们还回顾了众所周知的贬值力量。我们的分析强调，汇率并不能充分反映制裁的福利影响和有效性。（JEL D74, E31, F14, F31, F51, P24, P33）

articles.abstract_en: This paper examines connections between stochastic growth and decision problems. We use tools from the theory of large deviations to show that wishful thinking decision problems are equivalent to utility maximization problems, both of which are equivalent to growth maximization under idiosyncratic risk. Rational inattention problems are equivalent to growth-optimal portfolio problems, both of which are equivalent to growth maximization under aggregate risk. Stochastic growth generates extreme inequality, with nearly all wealth eventually held by those who happen to have faced empirical distributions that match the solution to the wishful thinking or rational inattention problem. (JEL D31, D81, D82, D83, G51, O41)
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了随机增长与决策问题之间的联系。我们利用大偏差理论的工具来证明，一厢情愿的决策问题等价于效用最大化问题，而这两者又等价于在特质风险下的增长最大化问题。理性疏忽问题等价于增长最优投资组合问题，而这两者又等价于在总体风险下的增长最大化问题。随机增长会产生极端的不平等，最终几乎所有财富都由那些恰好面临的经验分布与一厢情愿或理性疏忽问题的解相匹配的人持有。(JEL D31, D81, D82, D83, G51, O41)

articles.title_en: The Educational Consequences of Remote and Hybrid Instruction during the Pandemic
articles.title_cn: 疫情期间远程与混合教学的教育后果
articles.abstract_en: Using testing data from over two million students in nearly 10,000 schools in 49 states (plus the District of Columbia), we investigate the role of remote and hybrid instruction in widening gaps in achievement by race and school poverty. We find that remote instruction was a primary driver of the widening gaps. Math gaps did not widen in areas that remained in person (although reading gaps did). We estimate that high-poverty districts that went remote in 2020–2021 will need to spend nearly all of their federal aid on helping students recover from pandemic-related academic achievement losses. (JEL H75, I12, I21, I24, I32, J15)
articles.abstract_cn: 利用来自49个州（外加哥伦比亚特区）近10,000所学校超过两百万名学生的测试数据，我们研究了远程和混合教学在扩大种族和学校贫困成就差距中的作用。我们发现远程教学是差距扩大的主要驱动因素。在保持线下教学的地区，数学差距并未扩大（尽管阅读差距有所扩大）。我们估计，在2020-2021年转为远程教学的高贫困学区将需要将几乎所有的联邦援助用于帮助学生从疫情相关的学业成就损失中恢复。（JEL H75, I12, I21, I24, I32, J15）

articles.title_en: The Unequal Consequences of Job Loss across Countries
articles.title_cn: 失业后果的跨国不平等性
articles.abstract_en: We document the consequences of losing a job across countries using a harmonized research design applied to seven matched employer-employee datasets. Workers in Denmark and Sweden experience the lowest earnings declines following job displacement, while workers in Italy, Spain, and Portugal experience losses three times as high. French and Austrian workers face earnings losses somewhere in between. Key to these differences is that southern European workers are less likely to find employment following displacement. Loss of employer-specific wage premiums explains a substantial portion of wage losses in all countries. (JEL J31, J63, J64)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们采用统一的研究设计，应用于七个匹配的雇主-雇员数据集，记录了各国失业的后果。丹麦和瑞典的工人在失业后经历的收入下降最低，而意大利、西班牙和葡萄牙的工人则遭受三倍高的损失。法国和奥地利的工人面临的收入损失介于两者之间。这些差异的关键在于，南欧工人在失业后找到工作的可能性较低。雇主特定工资溢价的损失解释了所有国家工资损失的很大一部分。(JEL J31, J63, J64)

articles.title_cn: 金融、管理投入与资源错配
articles.abstract_en: In standard macrofinance models, financial constraints mainly affect small or young firms but not large or old ones due to the self-financing mechanism, and the dispersion of marginal revenue product of capital (MRPK) of a firm cohort is less persistent than in the data. We extend a standard model by allowing firms to hire managers, and large firms hire disproportionately more managers, consistent with data. In our model, financial constraints and the dispersion of MRPK persist, and even large firms are likely to be constrained. The productivity loss from financial frictions is also substantially amplified. (JEL D24, D25, G32, L25, M10, O16, P31)
articles.abstract_cn: 在标准宏观金融模型中，金融约束主要影响小型或年轻企业，而非大型或成熟企业，这得益于自我融资机制，且企业群体的资本边际收益产品（MRPK）离散度比数据中显示的更不持久。我们通过允许企业雇佣管理者来扩展标准模型，大型企业不成比例地雇佣更多管理者，这与数据一致。在我们的模型中，金融约束和MRPK的离散度持续存在，甚至大型企业也可能受到约束。金融摩擦带来的生产率损失也显著放大。（JEL D24, D25, G32, L25, M10, O16, P31）
